listing.name: In Game Log
listing.summary: View logs from starsector.log inside the game.
listing.aiSummary: Displays game logs on screen and in the console to assist mod developers.

description:
In Game Log

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Manual download
Requires LazyLib
Older versions and changelogs
View logs from starsector.log inside the game.

View logs on the top left of the screen via a scroller text renderer, accompanied by sound effects when they appear.

View logs in the console of the Console Commands mod.

Configurable.
Intended to assist mod developers. To see an error log exactly when it happens, in the game.

AI use disclaimer
Claude was used in code to make two classes in this mod.
1. ParseLog: The class which reads starsector.log files and converts them back into LoggingEvents to be replayed.
2. ErrToLog4jStream: The class which converts STDERR into LoggingEvents and logs them.

aiDescription: Shows starsector.log entries via a scroller text renderer with sound effects. It also displays logs in the Console Commands mod's console. The feature is configurable and intended to help developers see error logs immediately as they occur.
